meta.name: One Night With the Virgin CEO
meta.description: Five years ago, No Seo-yun was framed and cast out after a night at the Lumina Hotel left her pregnant. Alone, she raised her twins through hardship. A chance encounter leads to a flash marriage with Lee Hyun-woo, unaware of his true identity. As she endures humiliation, he becomes her only light—never knowing he is the man from that fateful night.
